name: 32843-batchdecode-qwen32bfp8-1gpu
model: Qwen/Qwen3-32B-FP8 -- public and ungated, ~32 GB of weights to fetch; dense, blockwise FP8 with `weight_block_size: [128, 128]`.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (SM90), one node, no router and no external cache tier.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP=1 -- one GPU holds the checkpoint and the KV pool.
architecture: Qwen3ForCausalLM, 64 layers, GQA with 64 query heads over 8 KV heads (head_dim 128), hidden 5120, intermediate 25600, vocab 151936, FP8 e4m3 weights with dynamic activation scaling, bf16 activations.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=48, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 960 requests with a 2400 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, seed 42. Prompts 256 tokens (stdev 64), generations 512 tokens (stdev 64), greedy with `ignore_eos: true` so a request produces exactly the number of tokens it asked for.
purpose: A long-form writing assistant on one H100, serving 48 concurrent users short prompts and 512-token replies.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only -- the engine's reader skips indented lines, so a nested block is
# dropped and the server starts without what this file declares, at rc=0.
model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-32B-FP8
tp-size: 1
fp8-gemm-backend: flashinfer_deepgemm
attention-backend: fa3
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
